value.rationale: The 85 objects are intrinsic and natural in Burkhardt modular geometry, and the arithmetic descent of their finite etale schemes matters to their splitting fields. A pair of rational counts at the smallest possible extension degree exactly determines two entire zeta functions for 20 actual forms, while five pairs of forms remain genuinely indistinguishable even over all finite extensions. This exact natural inverse theorem and its boundary are not a routine restatement of the 40/45 geometric counts or a merely sampled invariant.
